name: MUSE
notes: Kind is muon_precision with a hadron_structure secondary kind: the goal is the proton radius, measured with muon and electron beams.

physics_goals.quote: The PSI MUSE proposal is to measure $\mu p$ and $e p$ scattering in the same experiment at the same time.
physics_goals.value: Measure mu p and e p elastic scattering in the same experiment at the same time to test lepton universality and address the proton radius puzzle

summary.plain: An experiment at the Paul Scherrer Institute that scatters electrons and muons off a hydrogen target at the same time, to find out whether the proton looks the same in both and to help settle the proton radius puzzle.
summary.technical: MUSE (PSI R-12-01.1) on the pi M1 beamline: simultaneous elastic e-p and mu-p scattering from a liquid hydrogen target in a large-acceptance non-magnetic spectrometer, both beam polarities, to compare proton charge radii and two-photon exchange. Beam times from 2022.
